Both stationary branches, endpoints and the unique equality threshold Q=sqrt((11+5sqrt5)/2) are accounted for, with exact symbolic polynomial identities. Powers multiply Fourier coefficients and all degenerate boundaries a=0 or b=0 are handled. The standalone checker passed symbolic identities, independent high-precision segmented quadrature, discrete maximization grids and attaining witnesses. The infinite/all-parameter assertion rests on the proof, not on finite tests.
